sources.snippet: Built on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ExoMind achieves substantial and consistent improvements across scientific reasoning and research tasks using less data, a small model, and low-cost training.

sources.title: ExoMind: Democratizing Scientific Intelligence
sources.snippet: Frontier-level scientific intelligence at 35B scale ExoMind consistently improves over the base model on all eight datasets and surpasses leading open and closed-source models on most of them, achieving frontier-level scientific intelligence at 35B scale with roughly 277× fewer parameters than GPT-5.5.
